title: 工具使用循環：一來一往直到完成

bullets.text: 模型要求工具、程式執行、結果送回，然後模型再繼續。
bullets.quote: Make a second request to the model with the tool output

bullets.text: 程式持續執行工具並把結果送回 Claude，直到 stop_reason 不再是 tool_use。
bullets.quote: keeps running tools and feeding results back until

bullets.text: 多步驟任務需要迴圈：Claude 可能先建立活動、讀取確認，再建立另一個。
bullets.quote: Ring 1 assumed Claude would call the tool exactly once. Real tasks often need several calls: Claude might create an event, read the confirmation, then create another.
